name: Post ValenTimeline
source:
It's the month after Valentine's Day. All the pink and red decorations are coming down and making way for the next profitable holiday. The feelings it brought still linger in three coworkers at a small bookstore, who each wanted something more from it.

[From [url=https://dreadhime.itch.io/post-valentimeline]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
情人节过去一个月了。所有粉色与红色的节日装饰都被纷纷撤下，为下一个能赚钱的商业节日腾出位置。然而在一家小书店里，情人节留下的余韵仍在三名店员心头萦绕不去——他们每个人都曾期盼着能从那个日子里收获更多。

[摘自[url=https://dreadhime.itch.io/post-valentimeline]itch.io[/url]]
